claims.text: The Grand Palais was specially built for the 1900 universal exposition and stands right across the avenue from the Petit Palais.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Its most famous feature is the spectacular main nave, which is nearly 240 meters long and topped with an enormous glass roof.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: The building is a true engineering marvel whose massive iron and steel framework actually weighs more than the entire Eiffel Tower.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: From the outside, the classic stone colonnades prudently hide this incredibly innovative and massive metallic structure from view.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: During its restoration, careful analysis revealed its original paint color was a specific pale green known as 'vert réséda'.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Today, its vast spaces regularly host prestigious temporary art exhibitions as well as major events like Paris Fashion Week catwalk shows.
claims.subject: self
